import system

    try:
        pointer = self.parent.custom.Pointer
        basePath = "[default]sander_falldown/falldown"
        fdDataPath = "{}/FD_Data/{}".format(basePath, pointer)

        className = self.custom.className if hasattr(self, "custom") and hasattr(self.custom, "className") else self.name

        docPath = "{}/{}.Documentation".format(fdDataPath, className)

        tags = [
            "{}/barcode/barcode".format(basePath),
            "{}/Description".format(fdDataPath),
            docPath,
            "{}/{}".format(fdDataPath, className),
            "{}/product/construction".format(basePath),
            "{}/product/face".format(basePath),
            "{}/product/grade".format(basePath),
            "{}/product/grader".format(basePath),
            "{}/product/length".format(basePath),
            "{}/product/product".format(basePath),
            "{}/product/rating".format(basePath),
            "{}/product/run_number".format(basePath),
            "{}/product/shift".format(basePath),
            "{}/product/thickness".format(basePath),
            "{}/product/width".format(basePath),
            "{}/product/product_start_time".format(basePath)
        ]

        values = [q.value for q in system.tag.readBlocking(tags)]

        (barcode, desc, doc, classVal, construction, face, grade, grader,
         length, product, rating, run_number, shift,
         thickness, width, loginTime) = values

        params = {
            "barcode": barcode,
            "description": desc,
            "documentation": doc,
            "classa": classVal,
            "construction": construction,
            "face": face,
            "grade": grade,
            "grader": grader,
            "length": length,
            "product": product,
            "rating": rating,
            "run_number": run_number,
            "shift": shift,
            "thickness": thickness,
            "width": width,
            "loginTime": loginTime
        }

        # Insert the new row
        system.db.runNamedQuery("falldown/InsertRow", params)

        # Recalculate all ClassA to ClassE results for this reason
        for cls in ["ClassA", "ClassB", "ClassC", "ClassD", "ClassE"]:

            classValue = system.tag.readBlocking(
                ["{}/{}".format(fdDataPath, cls)]
            )[0].value

            docValue = system.tag.readBlocking(
                ["{}/{}.Documentation".format(fdDataPath, cls)]
            )[0].value

            countParams = {
                "description": desc,
                "documentation": docValue,
                "classa": classValue,
                "loginTime": loginTime
            }

            results = system.db.runNamedQuery("falldown/2A", countParams)
            count = results.getValueAt(0, "2A_Count") if results.getRowCount() > 0 else 0

            resultPath = "{}/Result{}".format(fdDataPath, cls[-1])
            system.tag.writeBlocking([resultPath], [count])

    except Exception as e:
        system.perspective.print("Insert or recount failed: {}".format(e))

    from java.util import Date

    # ---- Tag paths ----
    slotTags = [
        "[default]sander_falldown/falldown/barcode/scanQueue/slot1",
        "[default]sander_falldown/falldown/barcode/scanQueue/slot2",
        "[default]sander_falldown/falldown/barcode/scanQueue/slot3",
        "[default]sander_falldown/falldown/barcode/scanQueue/slot4",
    ]
    previousPackTag = "[default]sander_falldown/falldown/barcode/scanQueue/PreviousPack"
    packOnLineTag   = "[default]sander_falldown/falldown/barcode/scanQueue/PackOnLine"
    packTimeTag     = "[default]sander_falldown/falldown/barcode/PackOnLineTime"
    barcodeTag      = "[default]sander_falldown/falldown/barcode/barcode"

    log = system.util.getLogger("FIFO_Button")

    try:
        # Read slots + current PackOnLine
        reads = system.tag.readBlocking(slotTags + [packOnLineTag])
        slots = [q.value for q in reads[:4]]
        currentPack = reads[4].value

        log.info("Before shift → Slots={}, PackOnLine={}".format(slots, currentPack))

        if slots[0] and str(slots[0]).strip():
            newPack = slots[0]

            # 1. Move current PackOnLine → PreviousPack
            if currentPack and str(currentPack).strip():
                system.tag.writeBlocking([previousPackTag], [currentPack])
                log.info("Stored '{}' into PreviousPack".format(currentPack))

            # 2. Put slot1 into PackOnLine + barcode
            system.tag.writeBlocking([packOnLineTag, barcodeTag], [newPack, newPack])

            # 3. Write event time
            system.tag.writeBlocking([packTimeTag], [Date()])

            # 4. Shift queue (slot2→1, slot3→2, slot4→3, clear slot4)
            newSlots = slots[1:] + [""]
            system.tag.writeBlocking(slotTags, newSlots)

            log.info("Loaded new PackOnLine='{}' | After shift → {}".format(newPack, newSlots))
        else:
            log.info("No pack in slot1 to move.")

    except Exception as e:
        log.error("FIFO button failed: {}".format(e))
